title: Report case cache flattens existing loader error chains
symptom: Malformed case definitions produce different diagnostic formatting through report freshness than through the original structural loader
trigger: A report with a bound case encounters malformed TOML after the new cache stores loader errors as strings
expected: The existing loader error context and source chain remain unchanged while the suite is loaded at most once
actual: The report prints a flattened context string instead of the original multiline Caused by chain
source: Independent self-review of the new request-local cache after the initial full lane

notes.text: Added despite similar reports: This is a new cache error-chain compatibility defect, not the earlier actionable requirement hints or test filter newline issue

status: open -> verified. Retained the original typed loader error behind request-local shared ownership; original multiline cause diagnostics now match direct loading byte-for-byte. The regression failed first and all5focusedtests pass after the fix.
